title: Copper Peptide (GHK-Cu) 2% Night Cream

seo.title: Copper Peptide Night Cream 2% (GHK-Cu) | Skingenetix
seo.description: Nourishing night cream with 2% copper peptide (GHK-Cu), centella and shea butter. Wake up to firmer, smoother-looking skin. Ideal for dry or mature skin.

description_html:
A rich overnight cream with 2% Copper Peptide (GHK-Cu), ceramides and shea butter to nourish and support the skin barrier overnight.

  • 2% Copper Peptide (GHK-Cu) - our hero active, with the percentage stated on the pack
  • Rich, nourishing texture for overnight recovery
  • No parabens · no mineral oil · no synthetic fragrance

Best for: dry or mature skin that wants rich overnight nourishment and to wake up looking firmer and smoother.

Size: 50ml
custom.key_benefits:
- Overnight nourishment - a rich texture that works while you sleep
- Supports the barrier - Ceramide NP and beta-glucan for a stronger-looking barrier
- Firms & smooths - copper peptide for firmer, smoother-looking skin
- Deep comfort - shea butter and squalane for lasting overnight moisture
What to expect: soft, comfortable skin by morning; firmer, smoother-looking skin with nightly use.
custom.how_to_use:
Use in the evening as the final step in your routine. Warm a pea-sized amount (a little more if your skin is dry) and massage over the face and neck to seal in your evening serums. Its rich texture nourishes the skin overnight.
For a complete evening routine, apply after the Copper Peptide (GHK-Cu) Renewal Serum.
custom.clinical_research:
GHK-Cu, double-blind tested: 55.8% more wrinkle-volume reduction than the same serum without it.
GHK-Cu is a copper peptide your own body makes, first isolated from human plasma in 1973. In clinical research:
- 55.8% more wrinkle-volume reduction than the serum without it, measured by 3D skin imaging (40 women, 8 weeks)
- 7 in 10 people showed new collagen production after one month in a skin-biopsy study, vs 5 in 10 with vitamin C and 4 in 10 with tretinoin
- An independent 2026 systematic review found GHK-Cu significantly reduced wrinkle volume and depth compared with controls
Badenhorst et al. 2016, J Aging Sci (split-face, 8 weeks, funded by the tested serum's maker); Abdulghani et al. 1998; Mokhtar et al. 2026, Aesthetic Surgery Journal (two trials). Results describe the ingredient, not this product.

custom.faq_items.question: What does the Copper Peptide (GHK-Cu) 2% Night Cream do?
custom.faq_items.answer: A nourishing overnight cream with 2% copper peptide (GHK-Cu), centella, beta-glucan, shea butter and squalane. It deeply nourishes and supports firmer, smoother-looking skin by morning. That is 20,000 ppm of copper peptide (GHK-Cu).

custom.faq_items.question: When and how do I use it?
custom.faq_items.answer: In the evening as the final step. Warm a small amount and press gently into face and neck after your serum.

custom.faq_items.question: Can I pair it with the Copper Peptide serum?
custom.faq_items.answer: Yes. Apply the Copper Peptide (GHK-Cu) 2% Renewal Serum first, then seal with this night cream.

custom.faq_items.question: Is it too rich for daytime?
custom.faq_items.answer: It is formulated as a richer overnight cream. For daytime, we recommend the lighter Copper Peptide (GHK-Cu) 2% Day Gel-Cream.

custom.faq_items.question: Is it suitable for dry skin?
custom.faq_items.answer: Yes. With shea butter, squalane and jojoba it is well suited to normal-to-dry skin that needs extra overnight nourishment.

custom.faq_items.question: Is it suitable for sensitive skin?
custom.faq_items.answer: Formulated without parabens, mineral oil or added synthetic fragrance. We recommend a patch test first.

custom.how_to_steps.title: 1. Cleanse
custom.how_to_steps.description: Wash with a gentle, pH-balanced cleanser and pat skin dry.

custom.how_to_steps.title: 2. Apply your serum
custom.how_to_steps.description: Apply your Skingenetix serum and allow it to absorb.

custom.how_to_steps.title: 3. Seal with the Night Cream
custom.how_to_steps.description: Press gently into face and neck as the final step of your evening routine.
